description: Move a skill already installed on the runtime group attached to a Thalovant hub to a specific version (not a runtime group or skill set). The change applies live on the hub in about 15 seconds, with no hub restart. version is required — read the current version and latest_version from thalovant_list_hub_skills. The API answers 202 with an operation_id, hub_id, runtime_group_id, previous_version and state "updating": pass wait: true to poll the operation until it converges (state "installed", or an error carrying the operation's failure message), with a 120 s default timeout; otherwise follow it with thalovant_get_operation. Fails 404 when the skill is not installed on the hub (code hub_without_runtime_group when the hub has no runtime group), 409 with code skill_version_already_installed when it is already at that version, and 422 for an invalid version. hubId must be the hub UUID — the authenticated hub routes reject slugs. Requires the hubs:write scope and a paid plan; scope is checked before plan, so a free-plan token sees 403, never 402. A hub-restricted token must cover every hub sharing the affected runtime group.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait when wait is true, 1000-600000 ms. Defaults to 120000.

wait.description: Poll the operation until the update converges (installed or failed). Defaults to false.

name: thalovant_update_hub_skill
title: Update Hub Skill
